summary: First testing pass for TaxPilot dashboard. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases PASSED (100%) covering all 22 endpoints (health, profile, dashboard summary, clients CRUD+filters, documents+upload, GST recon summary+mismatches+resolve, TDS summary/missed/vendors, compliance calendar+mark-filed, settings profile+alerts, seed reset). Frontend: 12/12 Playwright checks PASSED across all 7 pages (Dashboard, Clients, Documents, GST Reconciliation, TDS Alerts, Compliance, Settings). Sidebar nav (7 links), client switcher, reset-demo button, Indian ₹ formatting (₹48.8 K, ₹1,18,000), DD MMM YYYY dates, IBM Plex Sans font, status badges (completed/processing/failed), Resolve buttons, 26Q XML button, Save->Saved confirmation all verified. Indian Lakhs grouping working. No dark-on-dark contrast issues observed.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — will warn in newer FastAPI; should migrate to lifespan context manager.
Performs N+1 enrichment loops over clients (await _enrich_client per client). For demo (3 clients) it's fine; could be slow with 100+ clients — consider single aggregation pipeline.
MOCKED — file is read into memory but OCR is not actually run (ocr_status returns 'processing' forever). This is intentional per the spec, but no background task ever marks it completed.

issues: Emergent dev runtime injects <span> children inside <option> elements causing a React hydration warning in console. This is a dev-runtime artifact, not user-visible, but worth noting — switcher itself works correctly.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown hooks to lifespan context manager.
(Optional) Replace per-client enrichment loop in /api/dashboard/summary and /api/clients with a single MongoDB aggregation for scalability.
(Optional) Add a fake delay/background task that flips uploaded documents from 'processing' -> 'completed' to make the queue feel alive.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is ~1075 lines — at the edge of the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (clients.py, gst.py, tds.py, compliance.py, settings.py) plus a seed.py and a db.py for maintainability.
_strip_id() mutates the input dict via doc.pop('_id'). Side-effecting helpers are easy to misuse; prefer returning a new dict.

datetime fields are stored as ISO strings everywhere (via .isoformat()) rather than native BSON datetime, which prevents Mongo range queries on dates from working efficiently — works for demo but should be revisited if production scale or date-range filters are added.
compliance_calendar() and mismatches() refetch the full clients collection on every request to build the cname map; an in-memory LRU cache or a single $lookup would be cleaner.
Pydantic response models (ClientOut, MismatchOut, etc.) are declared but never used as response_model= in @api routes — endpoints return raw dicts, so the models provide no runtime validation.
test_credentials: None required — no auth in MVP.
seed_data_creation: Tests use the auto-seeded demo data via /api/seed/reset fixture (firm-demo-001, 3 clients, 6 docs, 6 mismatches, 5 TDS entries, 9 compliance items). Final teardown re-runs seed/reset to restore clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — use this as the regression suite. All 22 endpoints fully covered with status + data assertions + CRUD->GET verification. Sidebar nav data-testids are nav-dashboard|nav-clients|nav-documents|nav-gst|nav-tds|nav-compliance|nav-settings (note: NOT nav-gst-reconciliation/nav-tds-alerts). Client switcher = data-testid='client-switcher'. Reset demo = data-testid='reset-demo-btn'. KPI cards = data-testid^='kpi-'. The /api/documents/upload endpoint is MOCKED — OCR never actually runs. App auto-seeds on startup; for state-mutating UI tests, call POST /api/seed/reset at the end.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. All flows working end-to-end.
